input.task: Which product in the catalogue has the lowest price?

provenance: The positive direction of loop-aggregate-single-read-at-answer-assembly: a guard that refuses every aggregate loop run would pass its own negative case and be worthless. One enumeration declaring `rank: true` is accepted, and the comparison is still done in code by `verifier.rank` — the loop does not get to pick the winner any more than a plan does.
